title: Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.15483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern deep networks are trained through long update trajectories, yet their temporal organization remains less systematically characterized than architectures, losses, or optimizers. We study short-horizon predictability as a measure of temporal redundancy: where, when, and under which training conditions recent updates contain information about near-future parameter motion. We combine three complementary probe families, displacement-direction, subspace-residual, and predictor-based probes, with convention-aware, null-calibrated group-level readouts, and apply them to multi-pass vision training on CIFAR and public Pythia pretraining checkpoints. Across both regimes, vector-like tensors such as normalization parameters and biases (auxiliary parameters) exhibit simpler short-horizon dynamics than matrix-like feature-transforming weights (bulk parameters), whose predictable behavior concentrates in localized, time-varying pockets. Agreemen

translated_title: 神经训练动态中的结构化可预测性度量：跨机制研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15483v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现代深度网络通过长时间更新轨迹进行训练，但其时间组织的系统性特征化程度仍不及架构、损失函数或优化器。我们研究短时程可预测性作为时间冗余的一种度量：近期更新在何处、何时以及何种训练条件下包含关于近期未来参数运动的信息。我们结合三类互补探针——位移方向探针、子空间残差探针和基于预测器的探针——以及考虑约定、经零校准的组级读出，并将其应用于CIFAR上的多轮视觉训练和公开的Pythia预训练检查点。在这两种机制中，向量型张量（如归一化参数和偏置，即辅助参数）表现出比矩阵型特征变换权重（主体参数）更简单的短时程动态，而后者的可预测行为集中在局部的、随时间变化的区域。
tldr: 本文通过三种互补探针和零校准读出，跨视觉与语言预训练机制发现，神经训练中辅助参数（如偏置和归一化参数）比主体权重具有更高的短时程可预测性，且主体权重的可预测性呈现局域化、时变特征。
en_tdlr: This paper uses three complementary probes with null-calibrated readouts across vision and language pretraining regimes to show that auxiliary parameters (e.g., biases and normalization) exhibit higher short-horizon predictability than bulk weights, whose predictable behavior is localized and time-varying.
